discrepancy_leads: L-01 Paper not recorded: arXiv 2606.15609 (FragFuse, USENIX Security 2026, v1 2026-06-14) describes this experiment family; profile [source].paper says none found and readme_corpora.toml has no [paper.fragfuse-agentharm] (documentation-mismatch, S3).

L-02 Unselected executions: inspect_logs_spot/ holds 3 Inspect JSON-format logs named *_agentharm_* (2026-01-03; 56.4 MB) outside the include globs, not mentioned in phase 10e/10h, the profile or the registry; the inspect.eval dialect reads .eval only. If they hold samples, the registry count 1,747 understates the published executions (documentation-mismatch, S2; scope decision needed).

L-03 Logs vs paper: the .eval logs are development runs (2025-12-25..2026-01-02 plain AgentHarm, 2026-04 retrieve and carrier tests); the paper's InspAgent results (GPT-4o/GPT-5.1/Gemini x LLM-AC/ShieldAgent, Table 1) are not in Inspect logs (iteration_4 JSON outputs only). No paper number maps directly onto a logged arm.

L-04 Retrieve experiment scored with always_ok: the 136 logs carry no harm/refusal outcome; the author's guardrail outcome (77 allowed / 59 blocked-or-error) lives in guardrail_decision.json context artefacts that the Inspect mapper does not consume (R-H3).

L-05 Undeclared arms: task.attack_id unrecorded for all (D-184); memory-agent router variants (mode_router/save_router, pre_router/post_router) on 3 logs are a further undeclared agent/defence-like facet; census tool-using samples 31 and 28 of 176 vs 117-122 for the default plan.

L-06 Producer defect, parallel tool batches: 1,617/5,078 tool events (620 samples, 0.3.154.dev37) and 155/567 (73 samples, 0.3.159.dev20) name another call's result; cleared by item 16 (accounting_inconsistent 693 -> 0).

L-07 CD-24: ScoreEvents lack `scorer` (pre-0.3.217); at 065b0d36 the mapper names them 'score' and emits a second, bench-attributed judgement per score value; SEM keys on combined_scorer.* and reads the duplicate (mapping-defect, routed RD-2).

L-08 CD-25: if any timestamp has a non-UTC offset, t.start/t.end are declared not_recorded and span ends dropped (mapping-defect, routed RD-2). Producers here are >= 0.3.151 (aware datetimes) and file names say +00-00, so 0 is expected.

L-09 Account paths: dataset.location (28 logs), memory-bank solver parameter (136), tracebacks (34 samples, 22 real) and metadata.carrier_query_path (4, second account) in raw; the profile still has no D-182 redact table at 065b0d36, so 25 executions carry an account path in AER ext (expected-known, security-relevant; D-186 option (c) ships raw as is).

L-10 Scoring version: AgentHarm task_version 1.0.0 (inspect_evals d9787f49), before every scoring fix 1.0.1..8-B and #2146; gpt-5-nano reasoning invisible to the refusal judge (#2107); benign meeting-location check cannot pass (#2101); unexecuted calls credited (#2108, issue still open; changelog 7-B fixes it).

L-11 Producer verification: no fragfuse producer is 53c1fa98, so the item-12/U6 rules resolve to their _unverified twins (class I) in all 1,747 executions; 0.3.158 (release, no +g commit) is not in the item-16 code lists either (no parallel batches there).
